Retry the same observation and require canonical DUPLICATE plus successful idempotent Census-R projection.

Yellowstone and WSS validated-observation health updates occur only after canonical ingress and Census-R commit.

followups.area: Solana V1 diagnostic wire decoding and signing boundary

upstreamFindings: Current official Solana docs list legacy, v0 and v1 formats and state that v1 is active; v1 places compute, loaded-data and total-priority-fee values in message configuration.
ComputeBudget instructions do not configure v1 messages; they are no-op instructions that still consume an instruction slot and compute.
The Veritas decoder uses pinned web3.js 1.98.4 VersionedMessage.deserialize and only returns legacy/v0 types; previously, v1 was rejected as a generic deserialization failure.

The Solana Foundation transaction-v1-examples repository at commit baa8b2654d1695d62c17dd8a0d2ef775ef45ad14 includes a TypeScript @solana/kit 8.4.0 serialized V1 fixture with message config and inline account keys.
sourceToPipeline.existingOverlap: Veritas now uses a bounded read-only parser to extract the V1 config values and structural instruction/account boundaries. It deliberately labels all V1 instructions UNKNOWN and returns complete:false; SigningFirewall rejects the message as TRANSACTION_DECODER_INCOMPLETE. This is diagnostic compatibility only, not transaction authorization or realized-fee accounting.
risks: The custom parser is not a runtime validator and does not fully interpret instruction effects, bind authorized signatures, or support address lookup tables; V1 signing remains disabled.
The declared total priority fee does not include or prove the actual transaction total fee; canonical confirmed meta.fee remains authoritative.
Adversarial review and broader property/fuzz testing remain required before expanding use of decoded V1 fields.
validationRequirements: Compare fields against official SDK-generated fixtures and preserve bounded malformed-input rejection.
Keep all V1 results complete:false and confirm SigningFirewall rejects the decoded message.

Do not enable V1 signing until official runtime fixtures cover every config combination, full instruction/account semantics, signer binding, canonical round trips, and independent protocol/security review.
Reconcile confirmed meta.fee for successful and failed transactions; do not treat message config as realized fee.

implementation.change: Added a bounded read-only V1 wire parser for the config mask, total priority fee, CU limit, loaded-account data cap, heap request, inline addresses, and instruction framing. All V1 instructions remain UNKNOWN and every decoded V1 result remains complete:false, preserving SigningFirewall rejection. Added deterministic SDK-fixture, malformed-message, and firewall regressions.

followups.area: observed transaction fee component reconciliation

upstreamFindings: Solana's total network fee is base fee plus priority fee; the base fee may include transaction and precompile signatures.
The v1 priority fee is a total lamport amount, while legacy/v0 derive it from requested compute limit and micro-lamports per CU.
A reported burned amount must be bounded by base fee, not just by total transaction fee.
sourceToPipeline.existingOverlap: EconomicDeltaEngine accepted feeBurnedLamports and priorityFeeLamports when each was individually no greater than feeLamports, even when burned fees exceeded the base fee left after priority fees. It now derives baseFeeLamports only when priority-fee evidence is explicitly present and rejects that contradictory decomposition.
risks: This consistency check does not prove that supplied fee components were decoded correctly for a given transaction version.
A missing priority-fee observation intentionally leaves base fee unknown.
Jito tips and venue fees remain separate economic components and are outside this validator.
validationRequirements: Reject burned fee greater than total fee minus explicit priority fee.
Keep the derived base fee undefined when priority-fee evidence is absent.
Add version-specific fee fixtures and reconcile them against canonical chain meta.fee before using for net PnL.

implementation.change: EconomicDeltaEngine now exposes baseFeeLamports = feeLamports - priorityFeeLamports when priority fee is supplied and rejects feeBurnedLamports above the derived base fee. Added deterministic regression assertions for contradictory and incomplete decompositions.

followups.area: transaction V1 signing decoder compatibility boundary

The signing decoder must fail closed until it can bind the v1 config and instruction/account structure from the exact message bytes.

followups.area: Jito tip-floor estimate conversion

upstreamFindings: The official Jito documentation describes tip amounts as part of a competitive auction and exposes the tip-floor API as a market observation, not as a guaranteed landing price.

The existing adapter converted the 75th-percentile SOL value with floating-point multiplication and Math.ceil, which can overstate at decimal boundaries and accepted coercible values such as null as zero.
